pcs.pc_description: analyzing quality of milk organoleptic ally by its flavor, odour, and appearance.
discard milk sample in case it is giving any foul, abnormal smell or have abnormal color.

blend 5 ml milk sample in test tube and add 5 ml ethanol and 4 drops of rosalic acid solution. Analyze color, rose red color indicates presence of neutralizer in milk, whereas brownish color indicates pure milk.
add few drops of 1% iodine solution in 10 ml of milk, to analyze the presence of starch. Development of blue color indicates presence of starch, whereas pure milk will not change the color
add 0.1 g resorcinol powder along with 10 ml HCl in 10 ml of milk, for added sugar detection. Heat milk in water bath for 5 min, color changes to red color indicates presence of sugar in milk.
verify fat, SNF and added water by using milk analyzer instrument.
ensure to heat the milk to 40oC before testing and then cool to 20oC. After thorough mixing take 20 ml of sample in the sampler.
validate fat content by Gerber method or using a milk analyzer.
verify SNF (Solid not fat) content by using lactometer or milk analyzer.
check acidity of milk by titrating 10 ml of milk with 0.1 N NaOH using 3 drops of phenolphthalein as indicator.
check COB (clot on boiling) test for heat stability of milk.

modules.module_title: Maintenance of milk testing equipment (milk analyzer) — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: ensure milk sample should be homogeneous, free from air bubbles and temperature of milk should be 10 oC to 40oC.
ensure milk is cooled and some of fats gets separated. Heat the milk to 40 – 42oC in water bath slowly and cool it down to 20-25oC for dissolving separated fat.
assure to stir milk while heating and cooling by ultrasonic stirrer to remove air bubbles.
manage rinsing three times by five cycles of water pumped in and out by selecting appropriate option. Contaminated water is poured out Option : Menu > Cleaning > Rinse
manage daily cleaning process by using 2% alkaline solution, prepared by mixing thoroughly 490 ml water in 10 ml daily clean concentrate Option : Menu > Cleaning > Daily Clean
clean in and outlet pipes with fresh water by using sample container and then by alkaline solution and rinse thrice.
ensure to clean the in and out pipes with fresh water after alkaline wash.
facilitate weekly cleaning by using 10% acid solution, prepared by mixing thoroughly 50 ml weekly clean concentrate and 450 ml water Option: Menu > Cleaning > Weekly Clean
cleanse in and outlet pipes with fresh water by using sample container and then by acid weekly solution and rinse for 5 times.
ensure to clean in and out pipes with fresh water after the acid wash Option: click the Menu key to come out of cleaning procedure
carry out manual cleaning by switching off machine and keeping fresh water in sample stand. Remove rubber plug and insert syringe plunger instead.
pull up and down plunger several times in order to get out milk residues out. Repeat process 3 - 4 times.
keep container on surface and using plunger check that no water is present inside sensor system.

remove plunger, insert plug and check with water for proper reading. in case pipe system have got blocked due to big milk solids, never apply more pressure, instead slow up and down plunger so that water movement is possible.
